comments.html: [...] illumos hackathon 2012: user-land types for DTrace – “At the illumos hackathon last week, Robert Mustacchi and I prototyped better support for manipulating user-land structures. As anyone who’s used it knows, DTrace is currently very kernel-centric — this both reflects the reality of how operating systems and DTrace are constructed, and the origins of DTrace itself in the Solaris Kernel Group. Discussions at dtrace.conf(12) this spring prompted me to chart a path to better user-land support. This prototype of copyin-automagic was a first step.” – Adam Leventhal [...]
